note: Mostly seasonal campground in 100 wooded acres around a 35-acre private lake near Percy: 90 annual sites, 29 nightly sites, plus tent and primitive camping. Sandy swimming beach, lakeside trails, hunters welcome. Water is on April through October; the shower house stays open all year. No ATVs or side-by-sides. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, about, contact, rentals), Google, Esri imagery read. Fees 25/25 -> 15/25 (water-only $15 is the base; layout-inferred), undated (checked 2026); booking phone, reservations required (manual); year_round confirmed; water hookups, 119 sites + pull-throughs, showers/dump/laundry added (manual). Long-stay: nightly share 29/119 = 24% (mostly seasonal, said in note); Google 4.2/129; not iffy. Price $25, under gate. WATERFRONT: lakeview -> not waterfront recommended (lakeshore units look annual; no nightly site shown on the lake).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (recommend lakeview -> not waterfront): the campground wraps the 35-acre lake, but every unit at the shore on imagery looks annual: the east shore (~38.0124-38.0132,-89.5985) holds trailers with roofs, decks, sheds and private docks (z19 tiles at 38.0126,-89.5978), and the west peninsula (~38.0128,-89.6010) holds trailers under permanent roofs with a dock. The operator publishes no site map and does not say where the 29 nightly sites are; seasonal-only sites don't earn the value. If the reviewer knows nightly sites sit by the beach (~38.0118,-89.5990), lakeview could stand.

LONG-STAY: nightly share 29 of 119 RV sites = 24% (tent/primitive count unpublished); operator lists '90 Annual Sites'. Booking wording is ordinary ('Call today to make reservations!'). Google 4.2 stars, 129 reviews. Not iffy: rates and site counts are posted, though undated. Keep with the mostly-seasonal caveat (in the note).

PRICE: base $15 (water-only) / $25 (water and electric), well under the $50 gate. The page lays the $15/night line level with '4 Nightly Sites with Water Only'; if it is the tent rate instead, base is $25. Rates carry no year; the site shows '2026 ACTIVITIES Coming Soon' so it is maintained.
OHV: none. The home page bans 'ATV's, side by sides, or modified golf carts'.
PIN (optional, under 250 m): stored 38.01251,-89.59752 is in the east-shore loops; Google's point 38.0116688,-89.5964459 (entrance/office) is ~130 m SE.
PHONE 618-615-7892 current, kept. WEBSITE optional: http://lakecampalot.com/ -> http://www.lakecampalot.com/ (the bare domain redirects there); either works.
